criteria.text: Desktop exchange with no refresh_token and narrower scope preserves the entire existing credential row, including access token, refresh token, scope, expiry, and identity.

When preserveScopes is enabled, a non-error row with refreshToken and any stored scope absent from incoming scope must remain entirely unchanged; this includes narrow/with-refresh, disjoint, and different-identity grants, and survives HTTP desktop exchange and forced ensureFresh refresh.
A covering incoming grant writes incoming normalized scope and tokens, including a different identity; a same-identity covering grant with missing refresh token retains the existing refresh token.
First Google desktop grant inserts Calendar and Gmail accounts with its scope and refresh token.
Duplicate/ordering normalization produces a stable normalized stored Google scope ordering.
Account/profile identity correctness: different owner and Google profile must not inherit another owner's scope or token.
Real Google OAuth remains manual not_tested; never use live credentials.
criteria.reason: Requires manual Google consent with operator-managed credentials; synthetic token responses only.

criteria.text: Disposable-schema Postgres gate proves narrow/covering and identity matrix, concurrent covering writes, and compare-and-swap retry with coherent credential rows.
Expired seeded rows; error-status narrow grant recovery exact credentials/expiry; covering writes expiry; different-identity covering/no-refresh exact null token.
Native HTTP response keys sessionToken/user, valid session identity, no credential strings.

Postgres: truncate before each, exact expiry/identity/no-refresh/error recovery; concurrent writers exact coherent winner tuples; forced CAS identity-switch and rotated-refresh retries with exact conflict evidence.

criteria.reason: Installed disposable server is PostgreSQL 17.11, not 16; exact PG16 remains a manual target.
